idea-plugin.name: Code Gschpänli
idea-plugin.description:
Little pets that live on your IDE itself: they walk along the status bar and the window header, nap on top of tool windows, climb up and down tool window borders, jump between surfaces and chase balls you throw. No extra tool window needed.
  • Two styles: smooth cartoon pets (cat, dog, fox, bunny, panda, raccoon, hamster, pig, koala, sheep, lion) and hand-made pixel-art pets (cat, dog, duck, frog, hedgehog, penguin, mouse, turtle, owl, squirrel, ladybug, seal), each in several colours
  • Random visitors: a changing crowd of one to three pets drops by and leaves again (on by default)
  • Click a pet to pet it; drag it to pick it up and throw it; right-click it to tell it to stay, follow you, play, nap or leave, or to rename, recolour or adopt it
  • Tools | Code Gschpänli: adopt, remove, throw a ball, roll call, show/hide
  • Settings | Tools | Code Gschpänli: size, speed, activity, name tags, visitors and which IDE parts pets may walk on

To hide all pets, untick Tools | Code Gschpänli | Show Pets. The plugin collects no data and makes no network requests.

Source code (GPL-3.0 with a linking exception for JetBrains IDEs) | Report an issue
